title: Receiving a part-sale core tags it Charged
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user. That role holds every permission, including Part sales -> Create & Edit and Invoicing & payments -> Create & Edit.
  2. A test customer exists. If not: Customers -> New Customer, enter a name (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and save.
  3. A test vendor exists to order parts from. If not: Parts -> Vendors -> New Vendor, enter a Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Parts Supply"), then Save & Close.
  4. Start a new part sale today (a sale started before this release handles cores the old way): Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, then select the customer.
  5. On the Parts tab click Add Part and fill the row: Description "Water Pump", Quantity 1, Vendor = the test vendor, Sell Price $517.55, and in the Core column a Core Charge of $79.99. Save the row.
  6. In that row's Actions column click Order and confirm. The row now shows Awaiting. Do not receive it yet.
  7. For comparison, a service work order with an ordered core: Work Orders -> New Work Order, select the customer, add a line, add a part with Vendor = the test vendor and a Core Charge of $79.99, and click Order. Do not receive it yet.
custom_steps:
1. On the part sale, open the Receive parts dialog for the special-order part.
  2. Read the tag shown on its core and hover it to read the hover text.
  3. Open the Receive parts dialog on the service work order and read its core tags.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • On the part sale the Receive parts dialog tags the core "Charged", and hovering it reads “Charged to the customer until the core is returned.”
  • The service work order keeps its own tags, "OK - returned" and "Not OK - charged", unchanged.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10262 (Story 1, Return a core on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 1; design canvas boards Cores_*/Document_*; read 5 Oct 2026 (specification edited that day). Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R24: “When a special-order part from a part sale is received, the Receive parts dialog tags its core Charged, with the hover text “Charged to the customer until the core is returned.” A service work order keeps its tags, OK · returned and Not OK · charged, unchanged”
